cli.description: Initialiserer en virksomhed og opretter standardkontoplan. Virksomhedens egen identitet (navn, adresse, CVR) og betalingsoplysninger (bankkonto/IBAN, betalingsfrist) registreres her én gang og flyder automatisk med på hver udstedt faktura og dens PDF.
cli.exampleNote: Eksemplet er en kommandolinje-skabelon — udskift <sti> med din egen virksomhedsmappe og vælg den momsperiode du er registreret for hos SKAT.
inputNotes: Ligger virksomhedsmappen i et workspace (via --workspace eller RENTEMESTER_WORKSPACE), registreres virksomheden også i workspacet, så Cockpittet kan se den.

--vat-period sætter virksomhedens momsperiode: month (måneds-moms), quarter (kvartals-moms) eller half-year (halvårs-moms). Standard er quarter. Vælg den periode du er registreret for hos SKAT — momsperioder og -frister følger dette valg.

--no-vat (eller --vat-period none) markerer virksomheden som IKKE momsregistreret — et holdingselskab, en frivilligt momsfritaget virksomhed eller en mikrovirksomhed under § 48-tærsklen. Hele momsstakken (dashboard, momsangivelse, deadlines) tier så stille, og købsmoms på bilag absorberes i udgiften via expense book --vat-treatment non_deductible.
Virksomhedsprofilen kan rettes senere med 'company set-profile' — du behøver aldrig at indtaste din egen stamdata på en faktura igen.

inputNotes: IKKE idempotent: et gentaget kald med samme --name/--slug overskriver ALDRIG en eksisterende virksomhed. Findes der allerede en virksomhed på <workspace>/<slug>/, afvises kaldet med 'a company already exists at <sti>'; et slug der allerede står i workspace-manifestet afvises ligeledes.
Slug'et udledes fra --name når --slug udelades. For at oprette endnu en virksomhed med samme navn skal et nyt, unikt --slug angives eksplicit.

cli.description: Retter virksomhedens egen profil efter init: navn, CVR, adresse, betalingsfrist, momsperiode og betalingsoplysninger (bankkonto/IBAN). Hver efterfølgende udstedt faktura og dens PDF arver de nye værdier automatisk — du indtaster aldrig din egen stamdata på en faktura.
cli.exampleNote: Eksemplet er en kommandolinje-skabelon — udskift <sti-eller-slug> og bankoplysningerne med dine egne.
inputNotes: Kun de flag du faktisk angiver, ændres — de øvrige profilfelter beholder deres nuværende værdi.

Angav du ingen bankkonto ved 'init', så sæt --bank-name/--bank-reg/--bank-account (og evt. --iban) her: uden dem får en udstedt fakturas PDF INGEN BETALING-blok, og kunden kan ikke se hvor pengene skal hen.
Bankkontoen er append-only: den oprettes ved første kald med bankoplysninger. Et senere kald opretter ikke en ny konto — opdatér i stedet kontoen direkte hvis oplysningerne ændrer sig.
--payment-terms er standard betalingsfrist i dage (udstedelsesdato → forfaldsdato), heltal 0-365.

--vat-period ændrer virksomhedens momsperiode: month (måneds-moms), quarter (kvartals-moms) eller half-year (halvårs-moms). Vælg den periode du er registreret for hos SKAT — momsperioder, -frister og momsangivelsen følger dette valg overalt (dashboard, cockpit, 'period close').
--no-vat (eller --vat-period none) markerer virksomheden som IKKE momsregistreret. Skiftet afvises hvis ledgeren har bogført momsaktivitet i en åben momsperiode — luk og indberet først.

cli.description: Åbner et lokalt, loopback-bundet cockpit for præcis én aktiv virksomhed. En ny eller tom workspace initialiseres kun med eksplicit virksomhedsnavn, actor og bekræftelse.
inputNotes: --workspace er altid påkrævet; kommandoen vælger aldrig en skjult standardmappe.
På en ny/tom workspace kræves --company-name, --actor <user:…|agent:…|system:…> og --confirm yes, før filer oprettes.
Kommandoen binder altid kun 127.0.0.1 og slår hosted Better Auth samt shared-token-auth fra, også hvis de findes i procesmiljøet.
Hvis workspacet har mere end én aktiv virksomhed, afvises launcheren. Brug 'rentemester serve --workspace <dir>' til flerfirma/hosted-drift.
--no-open springer browseråbning over og er beregnet til tests, headless brug og scripts.

cli.description: DESTRUKTIV: gendanner en backup til --target-company. Sletter ingen filer på source, men OVERSKRIVER eksisterende filer i --target-company. Kræver --confirm yes — uden den afvises kommandoen uden at røre filsystemet. --backup-dir kan pege på enten en backup-mappe eller et .tar-arkiv (kræver typisk --verify-key for et arkiv).
inputNotes: --confirm yes er påkrævet: restore kan overskrive filer i --target-company
Restore rører aldrig backup-kilden — kun --target-company skrives

--verify-key peger på den symmetriske HMAC-nøgle, der godtgør backuppens ægthed (manifestets HMAC-tag). Kræves typisk for et .tar-arkiv; for en backup-mappe udledes nøglen ellers fra virksomhedens backups-mappe.

--public-key peger på den asymmetriske ed25519-offentlige nøgle, der verificerer backuppens ed25519-signatur — den signatur 'system backup --sign-with-ed25519' tilføjer, så en uafhængig 3.-part kan bekræfte ægtheden uden at kende HMAC-nøglen. Den adskiller sig fra --verify-key: --verify-key er den symmetriske HMAC-nøgle, --public-key den asymmetriske ed25519-nøgle. Se docs/backup-security.md.
MCP-ækvivalenten system_restore_backup kræver confirm:true + confirmText='RESTORE <targetCompany>'

cli.description: Importerer banktransaktioner fra CSV.
inputNotes: CSV-headeren skal indeholde mindst kolonnerne: transaction_date, text, amount (valgfri: booking_date, currency, reference, amount_dkk, fx_rate_to_dkk).
Danske header-aliasser accepteres uden --profile: dato/date → transaction_date, tekst/beskrivelse → text, beløb/belob → amount, valuta → currency, ref/bilagsnummer → reference.
Datoer er YYYY-MM-DD. Delimiter (komma eller semikolon) detekteres automatisk fra headeren.
amount er i KRONER (decimal): POSITIVT beløb = penge IND på kontoen (indbetaling), NEGATIVT = penge UD (betaling/gebyr).
--profile <navn> bruges når en banks CSV ikke matcher standardformatet (fx 'danske-bank': semikolon, dd.mm.yyyy-datoer, dansk talformat). Uden --profile antages standardformatet.
--account <id|slug> knytter posterne til en bankkonto oprettet med 'bank-account add'.
Import-idempotens, fingerprint-felter og overlap-reimport er dokumenteret kanonisk i docs/bank-import-idempotency.md.

cli.usage: period close --company <path> --from <YYYY-MM-DD> --to <YYYY-MM-DD> --packet-hash <sha256> --review-id <positive integer> --confirm yes [--kind vat_period|fiscal_year|custom] [--status closed|reported] [--reference <text>] [--force yes --reason <text>]
cli.description: Lukker eller markerer en regnskabsperiode. En lukket periode blokerer ny bogføring med transaktionsdato i perioden — og er en forudsætning for 'vat momsangivelse' og 'report annual'.
inputNotes: --from / --to afgrænser perioden (begge YYYY-MM-DD, inklusive). Perioder af samme --kind må ikke overlappe.

--kind: vat_period (momsperiode for virksomhedens registrerede kadence — kræves af 'vat momsangivelse'), fiscal_year (regnskabsår — kræves af 'report annual'), custom. Standard: vat_period. vat_quarter accepteres kun som legacy-alias.
--status: 'closed' = perioden er afsluttet og bogføringen låst; 'reported' = derudover indberettet til myndigheden (SKAT/Erhvervsstyrelsen). Standard: closed.
Begge statusser låser bogføringen lige hårdt — forskellen er kun om indberetning er sket. Vælg 'reported' når du allerede har indsendt; ellers 'closed'.
--reference: valgfri fri tekst der gemmes på perioden (fx kvittering/journalnummer fra indberetningen).
--packet-hash og --review-id: PÅKRÆVET eksakt par fra 'period readiness' efterfulgt af 'period review'. En ændring i ledgeren gør pakken stale og lukningen afvises.

--confirm yes og actor er påkrævet. --force yes kræver desuden en levende owner-authorisation; lokal CLI failer lukket, fordi actor aldrig giver adgang. Åbne forhold gemmes som permanente obligationsposter.
En for tidligt lukket periode kan åbnes igen med 'period reopen' — en kontrolleret, fuldt revisionssporet handling. En 'reported'-periode (indberettet til myndigheden) kan dog ikke åbnes igen.

text: tekst (påkrævet)
lines: mindst 2 linjer; hver linje { accountNo, debitAmount | creditAmount, vatCode?, text? }

mcp.name: bank_suggest_matches
mcp.title: Suggest bank-transaction matches
mcp.description:
Foreslår deterministiske match mellem uafstemte banktransaktioner og fakturaer/bilag. Read-only.

Matching-signaler (deterministiske, kombineres til en konfidens-score): (1) eksakt beløb i øre mod åben saldo (issued invoice), gross-beløb (purchase_sale, credit_note_refund) eller delvist refunderet beløb (supplier_credit_refund); (2) invoice number / kreditnota-nummer / krediteret fakturanummer fundet som substring i bank-tekst/reference/counterparty/message (case-insensitive); (3) navne-tokens overlappende mellem bank-tekst og kunde-/leverandørnavn (stop-ord som ApS/A/S/DKK fjernes); (4) dato-nærhed (faktura: 7 dage, kreditnota: 14 dage); plus for supplier_credit_refund kræves et eksplicit refund-cue (KREDIT/KREDITNOTA/REFUSION/REFUND/TILBAGEBETALING/CREDIT).

Confidence-skala: float i intervallet 0..1. Forslag under 0.5 returneres ikke. Et match der kun bygger på beløb (uden invoice-nummer eller stærk navne-match med ≥2 tokens) kappes til 0.45 og dukker derfor ikke op — dvs. enhver returneret confidence ≥ 0.5 har altid mindst én identificerende corroboration. Typiske intervaller: 0.50–0.65 svag/usikker, 0.65–0.80 god, ≥ 0.80 stærk. En sikker auto-godkendelses-grænse er typisk ≥ 0.80.

Returnerer en envelope med data.rows: en række per uafstemt banktransaktion, hver med felterne bankTransactionId, date, text, amount (DKK), currency, reference og suggestions[]. Hver suggestion har { kind: 'issued_invoice' | 'purchase_sale' | 'credit_note_refund' | 'supplier_credit_refund', documentId, invoiceNo, customerName?, supplierName?, confidence, reasons[] } sorteret efter confidence faldende, derefter documentId stigende (deterministisk).

Rækkefølge på uafstemte transaktioner: transaction_date DESC, id DESC (nyeste først, deterministisk). Suggestions-listen pr. række er truncated til `max` (default 5); selve `rows` er IKKE truncated af `max` (én række pr. uafstemt transaktion i scope, jf. #381).

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

bankTransactionId.description: Optional id of a single unmatched bank transaction to suggest matches for. When omitted, ALL unmatched bank transactions are scored (ordered by transaction_date DESC, id DESC) — no implicit pagination is applied at this level. Use this to target a single transaction, e.g. after a partial import or when reviewing one row in the UI.

max.description: Maximum number of match suggestions returned PER bank transaction (not total). Default: 5. Suggestions are sorted by confidence DESC, then documentId ASC, then truncated. The result's `rows` array itself is NOT truncated by `max` — every unmatched bank transaction in scope produces exactly one row (with up to `max` suggestions); if you need to limit the number of rows, target a single transaction via bankTransactionId, or narrow the bank import. See #381 for the related pagination contract.

mcp.name: bank_import
mcp.title: Import bank CSV
mcp.description:
Importerer banktransaktioner fra CSV. Kræver confirm:true. Send enten csvPath (absolut sti) eller csvContent (rå CSV-tekst). BIVIRKNING ved csvContent: indholdet skrives midlertidigt til en tmpdir under os.tmpdir() (mønster `rentemester-mcp-bank-*`). Den tmpdir slettes altid før kaldet returnerer — både ved success og ved fejl/exception — så agenten kan retry'e uden at efterlade spor uden for virksomhedsmappen.

CSV-format (når `profile` IKKE er sat — den generiske parser): header-rækken auto-detekteres; kolonnenavnene matches case-insensitivt. Påkrævede kolonner: `transaction_date` (eller `date` / `dato`) — YYYY-MM-DD eller dd-mm-yyyy; `text` (eller `description` / `tekst` / `narrative`) — fri tekst der vises i Bank-listen; `amount` (eller `beløb`) — DKK med punktum eller komma som decimaltegn, negativ = debit (træk). Valgfri kolonner: `reference`, `currency` (default DKK), `amount_dkk`, `fx_rate_to_dkk`, `counterparty` / `modpart`, `message` / `besked`. For det kanoniske idempotens- og overlap-kontrakt, se docs/bank-import-idempotency.md (fingerprintet omfatter konto, datoer, tekst, beløb, valuta, reference, DKK-beløb, FX-kurs og occurrence). Den samme CSV kan retry'es uden dubletter (idempotentHint: true).

Find tilgængelige `account`-slugs med `bank_account_list` før kaldet. Den slug du sender skal matche `slug`-feltet returneret derfra; et ukendt navn afvises før parsing. write-reversible.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

csvPath.description: Absolute path to the CSV file ON THE MCP SERVER'S FILESYSTEM. Provide either csvPath or csvContent; csvPath wins if both are set.

csvContent.description: Raw CSV text, used as an inline alternative to csvPath when the file does not exist on the server. Provide either csvPath or csvContent.

account.description: Optional bank account identifier — the `slug` field returned by `bank_account_list` (or the human-readable name). When omitted, the company's default bank account is used. An unknown account aborts the import with a clear error before parsing.

profile.description: Optional named CSV import profile that pins the file's delimiter, encoding, date order and column→field mapping. Known value: 'danske-bank' (Danske Bank account-statement export). When omitted, the generic CSV parser is used (auto-detected headers). An unknown profile aborts the import before parsing.

mcp.name: expense_book
mcp.title: Book expense from bank + document
mcp.description: Bogfører leverandørudgift fra bilag + bankpost i ét tag. write-irreversible.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

documentId.description: ID of the ingested document (bilag) the expense is booked from. Find it with documents_list.

bankTransactionId.description: ID of the imported bank transaction that paid the expense. Find it with bank_list.

expenseAccount.description: Account number from the chart of accounts the expense is posted to, e.g. '3000' (Software og SaaS). See accounts_list.

vatTreatment.description: How VAT on the expense is treated. 'standard' = ordinary Danish purchase VAT, deducted as input VAT (default for a registered company). 'reverse_charge' = foreign service purchase (EU or non-EU) where the buyer self-accounts for VAT; persisted supplier identity selects the correct treatment (omvendt betalingspligt). 'representation' = entertainment/representation costs with the statutory limited VAT deduction. 'exempt' = the expense carries no deductible VAT. 'non_deductible' = VAT with no deduction right (for example foreign local tax, or a purchase at a NOT VAT-registered company under Momsloven § 37) — the entire VAT is absorbed into the cost basis and no 4000 input-VAT line is written. It may also be selected explicitly by a VAT-registered company. When omitted, the treatment is INFERRED from the expense account's default_vat_code AND the company's VAT registration. For a VAT-registered company: DK 25 % → 'standard', EU-service → 'reverse_charge', representation → 'representation'. For a NOT VAT-registered company (§ 37, no deduction): DK 25 % AND representation both → 'non_deductible' (the VAT is absorbed; the § 42 partial representation deduction does not apply), while EU-service reverse charge is REFUSED — it triggers a separate § 50 b erhvervelsesmoms registration that is out of scope. An account with no recognised default_vat_code is refused; pass an explicit vatTreatment in that case.

paymentAccount.description: Account number the payment is credited to. Defaults to the confirmed bank role; set it only when the payment came from a different account.

date.description: Posting date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When omitted, the bank transaction's own date is used.

text.description: Optional free-text description of the expense posting.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key (UUID/ULID, ≤128 chars). An identical retry returns the durable original envelope with data.idempotency.replayed=true; a different validated payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

mcp.name: invoice_validate
mcp.title: Validate invoice payload
mcp.description: Validerer faktura-payload uden at gemme. Read-only. Alle beløb er i kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimaler — ikke øre); vatRate er en brøk (0.25 = 25%).

invoiceType.description: 'full' for a full invoice; 'simplified' only for gross totals up to DKK 3,000.

vatTreatment.description: VAT treatment (default 'standard'). Reverse-charge variants also require reverseChargeBasis.

issueDate.description: Invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required.

invoiceNumber.description: Optional explicit invoice number. If omitted, a sequential number is assigned.

seller.description: Seller details. seller.name, seller.address and seller.vatOrCvr are all required.

vatOrCvr.description: Party VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678'.

name.description: Buyer name. Required for full invoices.

address.description: Buyer postal address. Required for full invoices.

vatOrCvr.description: Buyer VAT or CVR number. Required for foreign reverse-charge invoices.

eanNumber.description: 13-digit EAN/GLN number — required when invoicing a Danish public-sector recipient.

publicRecipient.description: Set true when the buyer is a Danish public-sector body (forces full invoice + EAN).

lines.description: Invoice lines — at least one line with a description is required.

description.description: Description of the good or service. Required on every line.

unitPriceExVat.description: Unit price excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK).

lineTotalExVat.description: Line total excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal quantity * unitPriceExVat.

totals.description: Invoice totals. All amounts are in kroner (decimal DKK).

netAmount.description: Total excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required for full invoices; must equal the sum of all lines' lineTotalExVat.

vatRate.description: VAT rate as a fraction (0.25 = 25%). Required for standard-VAT invoices; must be omitted for reverse-charge invoices.

vatAmount.description: Total VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required for standard-VAT invoices; must be omitted for reverse-charge invoices.

grossAmount.description: Total including VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required. For standard VAT it must equal netAmount + vatAmount; for reverse charge it must equal netAmount.

fxRateToDkk.description: For non-DKK invoices: FX rate from invoice currency to DKK (e.g. 7.46).

netAmountDkk.description: For non-DKK invoices: netAmount converted to kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal netAmount * fxRateToDkk.

vatAmountDkk.description: For non-DKK standard-VAT invoices: vatAmount converted to kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal vatAmount * fxRateToDkk.

grossAmountDkk.description: For non-DKK invoices: grossAmount converted to kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal grossAmount * fxRateToDkk.

vatComputationBasis.description: Optional VAT computation basis, e.g. 'VAT_20_OF_GROSS' for simplified invoices.

reverseChargeBasis.description: Legal basis for reverse charge — required for reverse-charge invoices.

reverseChargeNote.description: Optional free-text note explaining the reverse-charge treatment.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (default 'DKK'). Non-DKK invoices require the *Dkk total fields and fxRateToDkk.

dueDate.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be earlier than issueDate.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use this OR the deliveryPeriod fields, not both.

deliveryPeriodStart.description: Start of the delivery period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided together with deliveryPeriodEnd.

deliveryPeriodEnd.description: End of the delivery period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided together with deliveryPeriodStart.

payload.description: Danish customer-invoice payload. All monetary amounts are in kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals — NOT øre); vatRate is a fraction (0.25 = 25%).

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

query.description: Fritekst-delstreng (substring, case-insensitive) der matches mod både fakturanummer OG kundenavn. Ikke regex, ikke LIKE-wildcards.

invoiceNumber.description: Delstreng (substring, case-insensitive) der matches mod fakturanummeret, fx '2026-001'. Bemærk: substring, ikke eksakt — '001' matcher både '2026-001' og '2026-0010'.

amount.description: Eksakt bruttobeløb i DKK med 2 decimaler (fx 10000.00). Internt sættes både minAmount og maxAmount til denne værdi, så 10000 matcher KUN fakturaer hvor brutto er præcis 10.000,00. Til bank-afstemning eller andre flows med øre-afvigelser: brug minAmount/maxAmount i stedet.

minAmount.description: Kun fakturaer med bruttobeløb på eller over dette beløb (DKK, 2 decimaler). Kombinér med maxAmount for range-søgning. Ignoreres hvis 'amount' også er sat.

maxAmount.description: Kun fakturaer med bruttobeløb på eller under dette beløb (DKK, 2 decimaler). Kombinér med minAmount for range-søgning. Ignoreres hvis 'amount' også er sat.

asOf.description: Skæringsdato (YYYY-MM-DD) brugt til status- og saldoberegning på de returnerede fakturaer. Påvirker IKKE hvilke fakturaer der returneres (ingen dato-filter på udstedelse), kun deres status/restbeløb. Default: i dag.

vatTreatment.description: VAT treatment (default 'standard'). Reverse-charge variants also require reverseChargeBasis.

issueDate.description: Invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required.

invoiceNumber.description: Optional explicit invoice number. If omitted, a sequential number is assigned.

seller.description: Seller details. seller.name, seller.address and seller.vatOrCvr are all required.

vatOrCvr.description: Party VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678'.

name.description: Buyer name. Required for full invoices.

address.description: Buyer postal address. Required for full invoices.

vatOrCvr.description: Buyer VAT or CVR number. Required for foreign reverse-charge invoices.

eanNumber.description: 13-digit EAN/GLN number — required when invoicing a Danish public-sector recipient.

publicRecipient.description: Set true when the buyer is a Danish public-sector body (forces full invoice + EAN).

lines.description: Invoice lines — at least one line with a description is required.

description.description: Description of the good or service. Required on every line.

unitPriceExVat.description: Unit price excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK).

lineTotalExVat.description: Line total excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal quantity * unitPriceExVat.

totals.description: Invoice totals. All amounts are in kroner (decimal DKK).

netAmount.description: Total excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required for full invoices; must equal the sum of all lines' lineTotalExVat.

vatRate.description: VAT rate as a fraction (0.25 = 25%). Required for standard-VAT invoices; must be omitted for reverse-charge invoices.

vatAmount.description: Total VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required for standard-VAT invoices; must be omitted for reverse-charge invoices.

grossAmount.description: Total including VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required. For standard VAT it must equal netAmount + vatAmount; for reverse charge it must equal netAmount.

fxRateToDkk.description: For non-DKK invoices: FX rate from invoice currency to DKK (e.g. 7.46).

netAmountDkk.description: For non-DKK invoices: netAmount converted to kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal netAmount * fxRateToDkk.

vatAmountDkk.description: For non-DKK standard-VAT invoices: vatAmount converted to kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal vatAmount * fxRateToDkk.

grossAmountDkk.description: For non-DKK invoices: grossAmount converted to kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal grossAmount * fxRateToDkk.

vatComputationBasis.description: Optional VAT computation basis, e.g. 'VAT_20_OF_GROSS' for simplified invoices.

reverseChargeBasis.description: Legal basis for reverse charge — required for reverse-charge invoices.

reverseChargeNote.description: Optional free-text note explaining the reverse-charge treatment.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (default 'DKK'). Non-DKK invoices require the *Dkk total fields and fxRateToDkk.

dueDate.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format; cannot be earlier than issueDate.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use this OR the deliveryPeriod fields, not both.

deliveryPeriodStart.description: Start of the delivery period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided together with deliveryPeriodEnd.

deliveryPeriodEnd.description: End of the delivery period in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided together with deliveryPeriodStart.

payload.description: Danish customer-invoice payload. All monetary amounts are in kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals — NOT øre); vatRate is a fraction (0.25 = 25%).

mcp.description: Bogfører en manuel finanspostering i den append-only kæde. Kræver confirm:true. Modposteres via journal_reverse. documentId.description: ID of the underlying document (bilag). REQUIRED whenever any line posts to an expense or income account — the core rejects such an entry with 'documentId is required when posting expense or income lines'. Optional only for entries that touch balance-sheet accounts exclusively (e.g. owner contributions, bank transfers). Use documents_list to find an existing document ID.

sourceBankTransactionId.description: Optional ID of the bank transaction this entry settles. See bank_list.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (default 'DKK'). Non-DKK entries also require amountForeign, amountDkk and fxRateToDkk.

amountForeign.description: For non-DKK entries: the entry amount in the foreign currency, in major units (e.g. euros — NOT cents).

amountDkk.description: For non-DKK entries: the entry amount converted to kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals). Must equal amountForeign * fxRateToDkk.

fxRateToDkk.description: For non-DKK entries: the FX rate from the foreign currency to DKK (e.g. 7.46).

accountNo.description: Account number from the chart of accounts, e.g. '3000'. See accounts_list.

creditAmount.description: Credit amount for this line, in kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals — NOT øre). Set exactly one of debitAmount or creditAmount per line.

from.description: Only entries with transaction_date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Only entries with transaction_date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Filter by entry status: 'all' (default), 'posted' (active entries) or 'reversed' (entries that have been modposteret).

limit.description: Max antal rækker i dette svar. Default 500, hard-cap 5000. Brug sammen med `offset` til at hente næste side.

mcp.description: Lukker eller markerer regnskabsperiode (closed/reported). write-irreversible.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

from.description: Start of the period to close (inclusive), in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to.description: End of the period to close (inclusive), in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be before `from`.

kind.description: Type of accounting period (default 'vat_period'): 'vat_period' = a VAT period for the company's registered cadence; 'vat_quarter' is accepted only as a legacy alias; 'fiscal_year' = a full fiscal year; 'custom' = an arbitrary date range. status.description: The status to mark the period with (default 'closed'). 'closed' = the period is locked: no further bookkeeping writes are accepted into it. A 'closed' period can still be reopened via the CLI-only `rentemester period reopen`. WARNING: selecting 'reported' is IRREVERSIBLE — a reported period can NEVER be reopened, not even via `period reopen`. Only use 'reported' once the filing is final.

reference.description: Optional external reference for the closure, e.g. a VAT-return receipt number.

force.description: When true, bypass the open-high/medium-exceptions safety check (Batch D-7). The default (false) rejects the close with a clear error listing the open exception IDs that fall inside the period, so the owner cannot silently hide outstanding items by closing.

mcp.name: recurring_invoice_create
mcp.title: Create recurring invoice template
mcp.description: Opretter en gentagende fakturaskabelon (interval, kunde, linjer, moms, leveringsperiode). write-irreversible.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

name.description: Human-readable name of the template, e.g. 'Monthly retainer — Acme ApS'.

interval.description: How often the template generates an invoice.

firstIssueDate.description: Issue date of the first invoice this template should produce, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

invoiceType.description: 'full' for a full invoice; 'simplified' only for gross totals up to DKK 3,000.

vatTreatment.description: VAT treatment (default 'standard'). Reverse-charge variants also require reverseChargeBasis.

seller.description: Seller details. seller.name, seller.address and seller.vatOrCvr are all required for full invoices.

vatOrCvr.description: Party VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678'.

buyer.description: Buyer (customer) details. Required for full invoices.

vatOrCvr.description: Party VAT or CVR number, e.g. 'DK12345678'.

lines.description: Invoice lines reused every generation — at least one line with a description is required.

description.description: Description of the good or service. Required on every line.

unitPriceExVat.description: Unit price excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK).

lineTotalExVat.description: Line total excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal quantity * unitPriceExVat.

totals.description: Invoice totals. All amounts are in kroner (decimal DKK).

netAmount.description: Total excluding VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Must equal the sum of all lines' lineTotalExVat.

vatRate.description: VAT rate as a fraction (0.25 = 25%). Required for standard-VAT invoices; omit for reverse-charge.

vatAmount.description: Total VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required for standard-VAT invoices; omit for reverse-charge.

grossAmount.description: Total including VAT, in kroner (decimal DKK). Required. For standard VAT it must equal netAmount + vatAmount; for reverse charge it must equal netAmount.

reverseChargeBasis.description: Legal basis for reverse charge — required for reverse-charge invoices (e.g. 'EU_MOMSDIREKTIV_ART_196').

reverseChargeNote.description: Optional free-text note explaining the reverse-charge treatment.

invoice.description: The reusable invoice payload (an InvoicePayload) materialised for every generation. Do NOT set invoiceNumber, issueDate, dueDate or any delivery date here — recurring_invoice_generate derives those per period. All monetary amounts are in kroner (decimal DKK, 2 decimals — NOT øre); vatRate is a fraction (0.25 = 25%).

paymentTermsDays.description: Payment terms in days (default 30). The generated invoice's dueDate = its issueDate + this many days. Must be an integer between 0 and 365.

deliveryPeriodMode.description: How the generated invoice's delivery period is derived (default 'issue_month'): 'issue_month' = the calendar month of the issue date; 'interval_window' = the full interval window leading up to the issue date; 'none' = no delivery period is set.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes stored on the template.

mcp.name: invoice_send_email
mcp.title: Send invoice or reminder by email
mcp.description: Sender en udstedt faktura eller en betalingspaamindelse til kundens email via SMTP med PDF'en vedhaeftet og registrerer afsendelsen append-only. SMTP har ingen provider-reconciliation-kontrakt: læs den append-only delivery-evidens før et retry. SMTP-config laeses fra filen config/smtp.json i virksomhedsmappen; credentials gemmes aldrig i bogføringstilstanden. config/smtp.json er et JSON-objekt med PAAKRAEVEDE felter host (string), port (number) og fromAddress (string), samt VALGFRIE felter fromName, username, password og dryRun (boolean). Mangler filen, afvises kaldet med envelopen { ok:false, errors:["missing SMTP config: create config/smtp.json ..."] } — der kastes ingen exception. Den indbyggede SMTP-transport koerer KUN i dry-run: med dryRun:true registreres afsendelsen uden et netvaerkskald (ok:true); uden dryRun:true fejler et rigtigt send med envelopen { ok:false, errors:["the built-in SMTP transport runs in dryRun only ..."] }. Aegte levering kraever en injiceret EmailTransport. write-irreversible.

metadata.name: rentemester-accounting-draft-workflow-v9
metadata.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounting_draft_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  draft_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(draft_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version >= 1),
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('created','revised','submitted','rejected','approved_posted')),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash) = 64),
  canonical_payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(canonical_payload) BETWEEN 2 AND 262144),
  reason TEXT,
  journal_entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  actor_program TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor_program)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  previous_hash TEXT,
  event_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_hash) = 64),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK((event_type = 'rejected' AND length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000) OR (event_type != 'rejected' AND reason IS NULL)),
  CHECK((event_type = 'approved_posted' AND journal_entry_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type != 'approved_posted' AND journal_entry_id IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounting_draft_events_draft ON accounting_draft_events(draft_id,id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_accounting_draft_one_post ON accounting_draft_events(draft_id) WHERE event_type = 'approved_posted';
CREATE TRIGGER accounting_draft_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON accounting_draft_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'accounting draft events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER accounting_draft_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON accounting_draft_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'accounting draft events are append-only'); END;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  supersedes_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_kind IN ('direct','append-only','correction')),
  supersedes_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supersedes_id > 0),
  supersedes_reconciliation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  superseded_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  replacement_journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  bank_account_no TEXT NOT NULL,
  bank_amount_dkk REAL NOT NULL,
  replacement_journal_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(replacement_journal_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(bank_transaction_id, replacement_journal_entry_id),
  CHECK(supersedes_reconciliation_id = supersedes_kind || ':' || supersedes_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_current_idx ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events(bank_transaction_id, supersedes_reconciliation_id);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events WHEN NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id = NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_transactions bt JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.id=bt.bank_account_id WHERE bt.id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND ba.ledger_account_no=NEW.bank_account_no AND CAST(ROUND(100 * CASE WHEN UPPER(bt.currency)='DKK' THEN bt.amount ELSE bt.amount_dkk END) AS INTEGER)=CAST(ROUND(100 * NEW.bank_amount_dkk) AS INTEGER)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND je.status='posted' AND je.reversal_of_entry_id IS NULL AND je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NULL AND je.entry_hash=NEW.replacement_journal_hash) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries reversal WHERE reversal.reversal_of_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link WHERE link.journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries direct WHERE direct.id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND direct.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events replacement WHERE replacement.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_lines jl JOIN accounts a ON a.id=jl.account_id WHERE jl.journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND a.account_no=NEW.bank_account_no GROUP BY jl.journal_entry_id HAVING CAST(ROUND(100 * SUM(jl.debit_amount-jl.credit_amount)) AS INTEGER)=CAST(ROUND(100 * NEW.bank_amount_dkk) AS INTEGER)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='direct' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND je.id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id AND je.source_bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='append-only' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link WHERE link.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND link.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND link.journal_entry_id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='correction' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND event.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND event.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction must supersede one same-bank current target with an exact eligible replacement'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction events are append-only'); END;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bank_journal_reconciliations;
CREATE VIEW bank_journal_reconciliations AS
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT je.source_bank_transaction_id AS bank_transaction_id, je.id AS journal_entry_id, je.entry_no AS journal_entry_no, 'direct' AS link_kind, 'direct:' || je.id AS reconciliation_id FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND je.status='posted'
  UNION ALL SELECT link.bank_transaction_id, je.id, je.entry_no, 'append-only', 'append-only:' || link.id FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=link.journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted'
  UNION ALL SELECT event.bank_transaction_id, je.id, je.entry_no, 'correction', 'correction:' || event.id FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=event.replacement_journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted'
) SELECT bank_transaction_id,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,link_kind,reconciliation_id FROM candidates candidate WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.supersedes_reconciliation_id=candidate.reconciliation_id);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents d WHERE d.id=NEW.document_id AND d.sha256_hash=NEW.document_hash) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries j WHERE j.id=NEW.original_journal_entry_id AND j.document_id=NEW.document_id AND j.source_bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND j.entry_hash=NEW.original_journal_hash) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.id=NEW.reversal_journal_entry_id AND r.reversal_of_entry_id=NEW.original_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payables p WHERE p.id=NEW.payable_id AND p.document_id=NEW.document_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payable_payments pp WHERE pp.id=NEW.payment_id AND pp.payable_id=NEW.payable_id AND pp.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND pp.journal_entry_id=NEW.settlement_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries s WHERE s.id=NEW.settlement_journal_entry_id AND s.status='posted') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events b WHERE b.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND b.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.settlement_journal_entry_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'direct-bank purchase payable correction requires immutable linked evidence'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'direct-bank purchase payable corrections are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'direct-bank purchase payable corrections are append-only'); END;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS bank_journal_reconciliations;
CREATE VIEW bank_journal_reconciliations AS WITH candidates AS ( SELECT je.source_bank_transaction_id AS bank_transaction_id,je.id AS journal_entry_id,je.entry_no AS journal_entry_no,'direct' AS link_kind,'direct:' || je.id AS reconciliation_id FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND je.status='posted' UNION ALL SELECT link.bank_transaction_id,je.id,je.entry_no,'append-only','append-only:' || link.id FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=link.journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted' UNION ALL SELECT event.bank_transaction_id,je.id,je.entry_no,'correction','correction:' || event.id FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id=event.replacement_journal_entry_id WHERE je.status='posted') SELECT bank_transaction_id,journal_entry_id,journal_entry_no,link_kind,reconciliation_id FROM candidates candidate WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.supersedes_reconciliation_id=candidate.reconciliation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM direct_bank_purchase_payable_corrections correction WHERE correction.original_journal_entry_id=candidate.journal_entry_id);
